title: Fleet EpiDoc interoperability contract
principles: Native corpus records remain authoritative; EpiDoc is an interoperable scholarly representation.
Exports are loss-aware: unsupported native semantics go in an export manifest rather than disappearing.
Uncertainty, damage, restorations, editorial intervention, directionality, object context, provenance, bibliography and external identifiers are preserved where supplied.
required_tests: schema validation when validator is available
round-trip semantic comparison for declared reversible fields
admission_rule: An EpiDoc export is an encoding claim only; it does not certify a reading, decipherment, object identity, source independence or expert review.
